brief:
The "Al-Haris" platform, affiliated with resistance security forces, released a brief video on Telegram containing initial confessions from an alleged Israeli intelligence collaborator identified by the initials "M.M.," Shehab Wire reported. The video showed the suspect providing statements to interrogators.

The platform distributed the footage through its official Telegram account as part of what appeared to be a broader disclosure operation. The video segment was described as preliminary in nature, suggesting additional material or statements may follow. No details were provided regarding the suspect's alleged activities, the duration of any suspected collaboration, or the specific intelligence operations involved.
